boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 104 is a gravity board — green-arrow tiles only fall downward, and chain reactions ripple left to right as columns collapse. The danger is clearing the center too early, before right-column arrow tiles have settled, which cuts off the final chain reaction that sweeps the board clean.
landmarks: Block Out Level 104 is a gravity board — green-arrow tiles only fall downward, and chain reactions ripple left to right as columns collapse.
The danger is clearing the center too early, before right-column arrow tiles have settled, which cuts off the final chain reaction that sweeps the board clean.
The board mixes Cyan, Green, Orange and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Halve the left wall before triggering the center match chain.
Arrow tiles cannot sidestep — they need a full open column directly beneath them.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the top of the left stack through the upper exits to open the first downward column.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Pull green and cyan tiles out of the left wall before touching the center pairs.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Trigger the upper-middle match chain once a vertical gap runs beneath it (starburst around 01:42).

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Use the blue splash column to drop the remaining center arrow tiles straight down.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Sweep the right-side orange and purple arrow tiles through the right-wall exits.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish the bottom-row pink and blue singles after the grid is mostly empty.

failurePoints: Matching the center cluster before the left wall is half gone — right-column arrow tiles then have no drop lane.
Clearing bottom singles too early while upper arrow tiles still block the columns above them.
